findings.text: Field-name typo: destructures `publisherDate` instead of the Google Books API's `publishedDate`, and publishedYear derives from it — so publishedYear is ALWAYS null for every Google Books result, silently degrading match/cover data with no error.

axios misuse: axios.get(url, { params: query }, config) — axios.get only accepts (url, config); the third argument with the API-required User-Agent header is silently dropped, so the required User-Agent (built at lines 9-11) is never sent; also the only provider with no timeout.

Positional-arg mismatch: findCovers calls this.search(null, providerString, title, author, options) but search's signature is (libraryItem, provider, title, author, isbn, asin, options) — the options object lands in the isbn slot and distance/maxFuzzy options are silently lost.
runSearch else-branch silently falls back to Google Books for any unrecognized provider string, hiding an invalid provider selection instead of erroring.
Only provider logging via console.error instead of the Logger used elsewhere — inconsistent, loses log filtering.
`if (!timeout || isNaN(timeout)) timeout = this.#responseTimeout` guard copy-pasted into every provider method; items.filter(Boolean).map(...) || [] dead coalesce.
